sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Wait a sec — the diff says "add 1 rem 10", but I was expecting 2 changes (green 23→20, yellow 23→17). Only 10 cells were deleted and 1 was added... that looks like just one piece changed (10 cells deleted + 1 eye added = 1 piece shrunk by 3... no wait, if you shrink by 3 you delete 9 cells + 1 eye = 10 deletions, 1 addition).
Hmm, but I made 3 clicks: 1 C + 2 П. exec: 3. But the diff is only showing 1 piece's worth of change?
Let me check the image: green's body is columns 28-47 (N=20, eye 46). Yellow's body is rows 28-44 (N=17, eye 43). Both changed!
But the diff says add 1 rem 10... that's weird. Ah, wait — the diff is comparing previous_frame (before the first C click) and current_frame (after the 3 clicks). Both pieces changed: green 23→20 (3 columns deleted: 48,49,50 = 9 cells + eye move), yellow 23→17 (6 rows deleted = 18 cells + eye move).
Total expected: about 27 deletions, 2 additions. But what I got was 10 deletions, 1 addition?!
Hmm, maybe... previous_frame isn't what I think it is. Wait, "previous_frame is the frame before the most recent actual environment action." If the batch of 3 actions each generated a frame, then previous_frame = the frame before the last action (i.e., after 2 actions). So the diff is only showing the change from the 3rd click (П: yellow 20→17).
That makes sense: after C (green 23→20) and П (yellow 23→20), previous_frame = that state. Then the 3rd П: yellow 20→17. Diff = yellow only: 9 cells deleted + eye = 10 deletions, 1 addition. ✓
So current state: green N=20 (eye 46), yellow N=17 (eye 43). As intended.
No clear.
Next: (14,11): C×2, П×2.
